shortBulletSummary: Crypto Markets Rally. Bitcoin is firm above $84,000, and Citi has raised its BTC price target to $113,000.
US Jobs Report Boosts Crypto. A weaker-than-expected US September jobs report reduced Federal Reserve rate hike expectations, boosting risk assets like crypto.
Regulatory Landscape Evolves. The SEC proposed new crypto custody rules for investment advisers, while global regulatory efforts continue.
Geopolitical Unease & Hacks. An Iran oil tanker strike and exploits on Bitget and NEAR protocols add market risks.
Altcoin Sentiment Wanes. Social sentiment for Ethereum (ETH) and XRP has turned sharply negative after earlier gains.
